goals.title: Crate Readiness Rubric, Inventory, and Matrix
goals.objective: Create the crate-by-crate production-readiness audit framework before editing crates. Enumerate every workspace crate from cargo metadata and crates/*, define the readiness rubric, define required per-crate artifacts under docs/quality/crate-readiness/<crate>.md, create an aggregate matrix artifact, map each crate to exactly one tranche goal, and record baseline dependency and feature-flag topology. Rubric must cover manifest correctness, dependency direction, feature flags, public API, error handling, runtime behavior, test coverage, docs/examples, wiring through service-api/cli/mcp/xtask where applicable, scaffold/dead-code/fallback scans, security/reliability risks, and a production-readiness verdict.
goals.evidence: Created docs/quality/crate-readiness README, matrix, dependency-topology, and 83 per-package worksheets from cargo metadata; coverage check packages=83 matrix_rows=83 docs=86; rg trailing whitespace found no matches; cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo check --workspace, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace, cargo run -p xtask -- clean-room-audit, and git diff --check passed with CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTFLAGS=-C debuginfo=0.

goals.title: Core Contracts, Event, Session, and Replay Crates
goals.objective: Audit and harden these crates one by one: tdw-core, tdw-domain, tdw-protocol, tdw-config, tdw-event, tdw-actor, tdw-bus, tdw-cdc, tdw-outbox, tdw-snapshot, tdw-replay, tdw-rollout, and tdw-session. For each crate, produce its readiness artifact, verify manifest/dependencies/features, ensure API and error contracts are production-shaped, add or improve tests and docs where evidence is weak, remove scaffold-only or masking fallback behavior, and confirm downstream wiring into dependent crates.
goals.evidence: Audited and hardened G002 crates tdw-core, tdw-domain, tdw-protocol, tdw-config, tdw-event, tdw-actor, tdw-bus, tdw-cdc, tdw-outbox, tdw-snapshot, tdw-replay, tdw-rollout, and tdw-session. Added ActorContext::new with identity-plane test, EventBus retention_window/has_retention_gap with eviction test, InMemoryOutbox mark_dispatched bool with missing-sequence test, and SqliteSessionStore cost_entries with cost-ledger read test. Updated 13 readiness worksheets and matrix verdicts to Ready with follow-ups. Verification passed: cargo test for all G002 crates; cargo fmt --all -- --check; cargo check --workspace; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test --workspace; cargo run -p xtask -- clean-room-audit; git diff --check; crate-readiness trailing whitespace check.

goals.title: End-to-End Functional Smoke
goals.objective: Prove the bootstrap composition actually functions as a working system end-to-end. Wire tdw-service binary to accept a request through tdw-cli (or a programmatic harness), route it through tdw-app-server, tdw-app-client, tdw-runtime, and tdw-service-api, fetch from at least one provider (tdw-provider-fileset or tdw-provider-ws-mock is acceptable), persist to at least one storage backend (tdw-storage-fs is acceptable for this smoke), and return a structured response observable from the CLI. Capture an end-to-end transcript and add an integration test under tdw-test-utils or a dedicated smoke crate that drives the same flow deterministically. Document the smoke recipe at docs/quality/end-to-end-smoke.md so subsequent production tranches can run it as the baseline 'still works' check. Per-crate readiness worksheets receive a Smoke Evidence note for every crate participating in the path. Verification: focused cargo test for the participating crates plus the workspace gate set (fmt/check/clippy/test/clean-room-audit/git diff --check).

goals.title: Production Storage Transports
goals.objective: Replace the in-memory bootstrap storage adapters with real network transports for tdw-storage-clickhouse, tdw-storage-postgres, tdw-storage-s3, tdw-storage-qdrant, and tdw-storage-meilisearch. Each must connect to a real instance (via docker-compose service or testcontainers), preserve the existing StorageRouter fanout and degraded-health contracts, pass schema/checksum/health checks against the real backend, and route errors through typed Storage error variants. tdw-storage-fs remains the canonical local FS adapter. tdw-storage-router gains routing-by-config-key tests that exercise multiple real backends. tdw-storage-parquet/table-format manifest validation remains contract-only unless a real reader is also added. Integration tests live behind a feature flag (for example 'integration-postgres') so the default workspace test stays offline. Update per-crate readiness worksheets to replace 'in-memory bootstrap' notes with 'real adapter with dockerized integration test' evidence and update matrix.md. Verification: focused cargo test plus the workspace gate set.
goals.evidence: G010 complete: all five production storage transports are landed on main and covered by CI-backed integration tests. Postgres PgEngine, S3Engine, ClickHouseHttpEngine, QdrantHttpEngine, and MeilisearchHttpEngine are feature-gated so default workspace tests remain offline. PR #26 passed GitHub CI, including Integration, Property, and E2E Subset, then merged as commit 04d07e3.

goals.title: Production Provider Transports
goals.objective: Replace the request-contract-only provider crates with real HTTP transports for tdw-provider-alpaca, tdw-provider-binance, tdw-provider-fred, tdw-provider-polygon, tdw-provider-yahoo, and tdw-provider-huggingface. Each must execute real HTTP requests (with credentials from environment variables) and have a deterministic offline test path using replay cassettes (for example wiremock or vcr-style recordings checked into the crate). Preserve the symbol, path-traversal, and credential validation already in the contract crates; parse responses into tdw-domain shapes; route errors through typed Provider error variants. tdw-provider-fileset remains the offline FS provider. tdw-provider-ws-mock retains its mock streamer role. Add reqwest (rustls TLS) as a workspace dependency. Update worksheets and matrix.md to record real-transport evidence. Verification: focused cargo test plus the workspace gate set, with the live-API tests gated behind a feature flag and a CARGO env opt-in.

goals.title: Production LLM and Embedding Transports
goals.objective: Make tdw-llm-anthropic and tdw-llm-openai-compat actually execute LanguageModel chat requests against their respective HTTP APIs, with replay cassettes for deterministic CI. Add real embedding execution for tdw-embed-openai and tdw-embed-google. Preserve the tdw-llm and tdw-embed contract validation (model ID guard, base URL guard, finite-vector validation). Add streaming response support where the underlying API supports it (Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible). tdw-embed-local stays offline as the hash-embedding default. Surface credential handling as a typed error rather than panic. Worksheets updated. Verification: focused cargo test plus the workspace gate set; live-API tests gated behind a feature flag.

goals.title: Durable Persistence Backends
goals.objective: Replace in-memory and SQLite-only persistence with durable production backends behind feature flags so the in-memory paths remain the bootstrap/test default. tdw-outbox gains a Postgres-backed implementation; tdw-cdc and tdw-replay consume offsets from the real outbox. tdw-session SqliteSessionStore is supplemented by a Postgres-backed SessionStore for multi-tenant deployments. tdw-bus retention enforcement gains a persistent backend option (Postgres or Redis). tdw-snapshot and tdw-rollout add real durable storage paths (filesystem with locking, or object-store backed). Each new backend has integration tests against a real database (gated by feature flag). Update worksheets and matrix.md to record durable-backend evidence. Verification: focused cargo test plus the workspace gate set.

goals.title: Release Packaging
goals.objective: Produce shippable release artifacts. Add a multi-stage Dockerfile per binary (tdw-service, tdw-cli, tdw-mcp, tdw-worker) using cargo-chef or equivalent for layer caching. Add a docker-compose.yml that brings up the full stack (tdw-service, tdw-worker, postgres, clickhouse, qdrant, meilisearch, MinIO or LocalStack) for local end-to-end testing. Add a GitHub release workflow that builds the four binaries for linux-x86_64, darwin-aarch64, and windows-x86_64 and uploads them to GitHub Releases on vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH tag push. Add ADR 0013 documenting the release process. Update CI to build and push images to GHCR on every main push. Define the version policy (semver, pre-1.0 increment scheme) in AGENTS.md or a dedicated docs page. Verification: dockerized end-to-end smoke (from G009) must run inside docker-compose; release workflow must produce signed binaries; image scan must pass.

goals.title: Policy Enforcement Binding
goals.objective: Wire the hook, auth, sandbox, and mask validation contracts into actual request-path enforcement. tdw-hooks runtime gains real handler execution (command runner with capability boundaries, HTTP caller, MCP client) instead of declarative-only. tdw-auth role checks gate every tdw-service-api endpoint with deny-by-default. tdw-auth-oidc JWT validation runs on incoming requests at the transport boundary. tdw-sandbox capabilities are enforced when tdw-udf executes user code (deny network/filesystem unless explicitly granted). tdw-mask masking rules apply to outgoing responses end-to-end. tdw-define declarative events are reachable from real end-to-end flows. Add request-path integration tests proving denied actions actually fail (and accepted actions actually succeed). Worksheets updated to record real enforcement evidence. Verification: focused cargo test plus the workspace gate set, with a dedicated permission-deny integration suite.

goals.title: Aggregate Production-Functional Gate
goals.objective: Final verification gate for the production functionality push. Confirm every G009-G015 story has its evidence captured; every readiness worksheet for affected crates reflects 'production' rather than 'bootstrap contract'; docker-compose end-to-end run completes cleanly using the G014 stack; CI builds and pushes images on main; release artifacts exist for at least one vN.M.P tag; the policy-enforcement integration tests from G015 are part of the workspace test suite. Update docs/quality/release-readiness-summary.md to mark the production-functional push as APPROVE/CLEAR (the existing G008 summary becomes the bootstrap baseline section). Run cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo check --workspace, cargo test --workspace, cargo run -p xtask -- clean-room-audit, git diff --check, ai-slop-cleaner on changed files, and a final code-review with recommendation APPROVE and architectStatus CLEAR before completing the Codex goal.
